instruments.legal_status: Mandatory standards for California public water systems under HSC116407; revised handbook adopted and effective April21,2026 by resolution2026-0013. Original effective July1,2024; June17,2025 revision extended compliance dates.
instruments.applicability: All PWSs as HSC116275(h) defines; includes privately owned qualifying systems and PWS service requirements affecting customer-premises backflow assemblies. Does not independently regulate non-PWS state small systems or recycled-water supply protection. Plumbing code and applicable local water rules remain separate.
instruments.reason: Backflow installation, field testing/repair, certified tester/specialist qualifications, premises hazards, service protection and records can directly condition residential physical work.
